description: Get the current spot price to have a verified human check, agree on, sign off or notarise something. Use when an agent needs human judgment, accountability or a signature, and needs to know the cost and time before committing. Returns an indicative price, a band, what would clear at a lower bid, and the implied rate per human minute.

consensus_n.description: Odd quorum size for the consensus tier.

criteria.description: Required for a market priced per criterion, currently countersign.accessibility_statement, and rejected for any other. The criteria to examine, each priced from its published effort class and summed. GET /v1/methodology publishes the class table and every valid id.

id.description: A WCAG 2.2 success criterion, e.g. 1.4.3: the leading token of an evidence pack's criterion string.

measured.description: True when the pack row carries a measured value. A measured automated-fail is priced as a confirmation, which is cheaper.

status.description: The machine's result for this criterion, from the evidence pack row.

jurisdiction.description: Two-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, for example GB or US. UK is accepted as an alias for GB.

market.description: The market id from the spot index, e.g. countersign.accessibility_statement. Pass the id verbatim.

max_price.description: Your maximum bid in USD. The response says whether it clears.

sla_seconds.description: Deadline in seconds. 300 is five minutes.

tier.description: check: one screened human, a score at stake. consensus: N humans, majority resolves. countersign: a named, register-verified professional attaches their name. seal: a regulated act by a licensed partner.

unassisted.description: Require unassisted human perception. Carries a premium.

name: countersignatory_quote
title: Price a task
